status: RESEARCH ONLY - no production data added, altered or replaced

archived_sources.source: MansMeg/SwedishPolls (GitHub) — upstream metadata source for the repository's poll dates and sample sizes
archived_sources.purpose: Verify at source whether the 1991/1994/1998 fieldwork dates and sample sizes missing from the repository are recoverable upstream.
archived_sources.access_caveat: Community-maintained research dataset. Upstream documentation states earlier data has more NA in sample size and collection period, and that quality improves from 2008.

archived_sources.purpose: Authoritative statement of the mandate-allocation rules currently in force (post-2018), used as the reference point for identifying what differs in 2010/2014.

archived_sources.source: Regeringen — Proposition 2013/14:48 'Proportionell fördelning av mandat och förhandsanmälan av partier i val'
archived_sources.purpose: Primary legal source for the change of the modified Sainte-Lague first divisor from 1.4 to 1.2 and the introduction of mandate return (aterforing), both effective from the 2018 election (enacted as SFS 2014:1384).

cited_sources.note: Cited, not archived. Official presentations run 2002-2018; no official presentation is offered for 1998, 1994 or 1991.
